concept.hr: stdin, stdout, stderr; poredak > i 2>&1; cijev nosi samo deskriptor 1
concept.en: stdin, stdout, stderr; the order of > and 2>&1; a pipe carries only fd 1

summary.hr: Ljuska slaže kamo vodi svaki deskriptor, korak po korak: cijevi, pa preusmjeravanja slijeva nadesno, pa ispis redak po redak.
summary.en: The shell sets up where each descriptor points, step by step: pipes, then redirections left to right, then output line by line.

title.en: 2>&1 before > : the error stays on the screen

concept.hr: Preusmjeravanja idu slijeva nadesno: 2 kopira 1 dok 1 još vodi na zaslon
concept.en: Redirections apply left to right: 2 copies 1 while 1 still points to the screen

concept.hr: Cijev se spaja prije preusmjeravanja, pa 2>&1 šalje grešku u cijev
concept.en: The pipe is connected before redirections, so 2>&1 sends the error into it
